data.description:
## Observation
Since 2026-10-30 13:24 PDT every Gerrit change fails the lint + type-check job (example: change 3157, run 41125326030). zizmor v1.29.0 reports error[known-vulnerable-actions] at .github/workflows/release.yml:283: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@dc37677b2e1c63e2034f94d8a5b11f265b73ba33 (v1.14.2) is affected by GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 (critical, published 2026-10-30 20:24 UTC): versions <= 1.14.2 bundle certifi's emSign root CA, which the advisory revokes after an external compromise; Sigstore uses that trust store for Trusted Publishing and attestations. First patched version is v1.14.3, tag object aef6c9b6, commit 7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 (gh api, verified). The release workflow is the 0.14.0 publish path, so this also blocks the release.

Related: the evidence-shapin fragment in release.yml (line 111) labels the same pinned SHA '# v1.14.0', disagreeing with the uses: line's '# v1.14.2'.

## Plan
1. Pin pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish in .github/workflows/release.yml to 7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3 at the uses: line and in the evidence-shapin echo, so both state the same SHA and version.
2. Run make lint locally (includes zizmor and actionlint) and the workflow parity tests.
3. Push, land at LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] release.yml pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish at 7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 in both places, both labelled v1.14.3; verified by grep showing no remaining dc37677b reference.
- [ ] make lint passes locally with zizmor reporting no known-vulnerable-actions finding.
- [ ] The Gerrit change is Verified +1 (CI lint + type-check job green).
data.title: Bump pypi-publish past GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9; every change fails lint
